scope: G3 functional branch only: one metadata-only phase Advance of a selected completed job, reserved in C and selected by a second NV dispatch in a real migrated V2 store, with a cold replay of both events; no production caller, produced image, GWIN0 package, installed run or native C activation

branch_policy.owner_decision: On 29 October 2026 the owner kept further sequence-19 G2 testing and GWIN0 completion on feature/g3-gwin0-beta and moved G3 functional development to this branch in the words: complete G3 in a different branch till we fully test G2 and complete GWIN0. This checkpoint is the next step of that work; no separate owner approval of it is claimed

implementation: reserve_index_advance_direct (direct/worker.rs) takes an Advance request and the job the caller holds. C requires that job's digest to equal the selected leaf's current job, and the leaf must have no unresolved preparation. The reservation takes one NV dispatch and writes nothing to the store

The JobAdvance record (index/effects/job_advance.rs, domain luma-c-index-job-advance-v1) reconstructs the next job from the selected job and the current fixed builder. No worker JSON, review hash or job bytes are accepted as input. An advance writes one job blob and no window objects, so it has its own reservation and selection in place of a phase preparation

select_index_advance_direct (direct/worker/index_select.rs) runs under a new original operation. It reads the base job through the store, compares it with the caller's job before writing, writes the reserved next job and reads it back

The AdvanceSelection record (domain luma-c-index-advance-selection-v1) names the reservation, the next job, the measured physical accounting and the new original. One NV dispatch selects it, so the leaf's current job becomes the next job and the event resolves the reservation

direct/worker/index_cold.rs and index_select_cold.rs, with index/effects/selected.rs, replay both events from a cold reopen. The replay proves the record shape, the liability and capacity arithmetic and the input, source and attribution tuple. The next job and measured inventory are selection data, so it does not re-read the store bytes

The publisher still has no production caller. Production builds do not compile the direct publisher, its cold verifiers, the index effects module or the test-only IndexAdvanceReservation and IndexAdvanceSelection variants

test_behaviour: New test: over the preparation cut left by the ingest window helper, a reservation is refused because a pending preparation fences an Advance, and a selection fails parsing that preparation record as an Advance reservation
Over the selected completed job, 9 reservation substitutes are each refused with a specific text, no NV dispatch and an unchanged store inventory. before_nv_refusals gives each text

The honest reservation is one NV dispatch and leaves the store unchanged. A cold reopen selects it with the same binding, input, reservation and original, with sequence one higher, the owners root unchanged and the index generations root changed. The selected state shows it charged, the physical accounting equal to the stored inventory and the current job unchanged
No other consumer takes the reservation: a phase preparation, a phase run, a Start selection and a second reservation are each refused with no NV dispatch and an unchanged store
24 forged candidates of the reservation are then each refused by the cold verifier, and the NV call count and page inventory stay unchanged
8 selection substitutes are each refused with no NV dispatch and an unchanged store

An interrupted selection: the actual worker writes all 3 members (one chunk, one group, a blob index) and its original is revoked right after the last, so nothing reaches NV and incomplete objects stay unchanged. A new original reconciles those members with one dispatch and writes nothing more

A cold reopen selects the Advance with sequence one higher, changed owners and index generations roots and one index generations entry, the reservation resolved and the physical accounting equal to the measured inventory. The job read through its selected reference is Stage::Statistics with the same job id, one higher revision, the old job as previous_job_sha256 and the Advance as last_request_id
The Advance is not repeatable: a second selection, a second reservation over the old job and an Advance of the new Statistics job are each refused
24 forged candidates of the selection are then each refused by the cold verifier with the same closure

Neither record class answers for the other: each of the two reservation classes and each of the two selection classes is relabelled as its counterpart in a sealed candidate and refused. No dispatch happens, the store and page inventories stay unchanged and the selected event still reopens
18 effects tests pass, six of them new, in the unit form of the same records
